@graph.description: Interactive calculator that converts hiring metrics — time-to-fill, vacancy cost, and cost per hire — into estimated recruiting ROI for talent leaders.

mainEntity.name: What inputs does the ROI calculator need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically: number of hires per year, average time-to-fill, daily cost of unfilled roles, and recruiting cost per hire. These inputs are usually available in HR dashboards or finance reports.

This simple model focuses on time and cost. For quality-of-hire metrics (like performance ratings), you’d need a more advanced model. However, improving hiring speed and cost often indirectly improves quality by allowing better candidates to stay engaged.

mainEntity.name: How accurate is the ROI estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: It provides an estimate based on your inputs. It’s most useful for relative comparisons (e.g. project A yields higher ROI than B), not a precise forecast. Always treat it as a directional guide and update with real data over time.
